curated.instructions: omr/instructions/42066-1-1.pdf (one book: M motor and gearbox steps 10-21, finished jet page 245, functions pages 246-247)

functions.does: The M motor, switched on at the battery box, runs a gearbox with two outputs; the two red levers on top of the fuselage, behind the cockpit, each connect one output forwards, backwards or not at all. Inside, the motor's 8 tooth gear drives a 24 tooth clutch gear, whose 12 tooth gear turns a 20 tooth gear on a long shaft down to two 16 tooth gears on each output axle, one turning each way; a driving ring on each output axle, slid by its lever, picks one.
functions.source: book: steps 10-21 (motor and gearbox), page 247 (top inset: the two levers, each up or down); the gear train is read from the model
functions.note: The motor (p22 58120) turns the control, the 8 tooth gear on its shaft. The battery box is p1172 58119; the levers are p1096 6641 (right) and p1095 6641 (left). The 24 tooth clutch gear (p135 76019) slips when a function reaches its end.

functions.does: With the right lever set, the motor raises and lowers the landing gear: a worm on the right output turns a 24 tooth gear whose arms push links that fold the two main legs up into the wings, and a long rod forward folds the nose leg up into the nose.
functions.source: book: page 247 (lower orange picture: both legs folding); which lever works the landing gear is inferred from the model's gears and links
functions.note: Driven by the motor through the gearbox; the control is the worm on the right output axle.

functions.does: With the left lever set, the motor opens and closes the canopy, lowers the air brake under the fuselage and swivels the exhaust at the tail, all together: a worm on the left output turns a 24 tooth gear whose arms push links and long rods to all three.
functions.source: book: page 247 (upper orange picture: canopy up, air brake down, exhaust swivelling), page 246 (lower inset: the canopy open); which lever works these, and the links, are inferred from the model
functions.note: Driven by the motor through the gearbox; the control is the worm on the left output axle. p669 is on the canopy, p720 on the hatch under the cockpit (taken to be the air brake: unsure), p1166 on the exhaust.

functions.does: The black knob on top of the fuselage between the tail fins turns both red rudders together: it turns a cross block whose two steering links push the rudders' arms.
functions.source: book: page 246 (top inset: the knob turned, the rudders swinging)

functions.does: The black knob on top of the fuselage behind the cockpit steers the nose wheel, through an upright shaft with a universal joint down the nose leg.
functions.source: book: page 246 (middle inset: the knob turned, the nose wheel turning)

functions.does: The two main wheels and the twin nose wheels roll freely.

questions.question: Which way does each lever go for which function? The `first` amounts in this file are guesses.
